Since '.' is NOT in the urlsafe-b64 alphabet (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, -, _, =), rsplit('.', 1) is deterministic — bug class permanently closed. Fuzz test locks this invariant at 200 iterations.

Pre-existing failure tests/test_usd_only_migration.py::test_dynamic_ring_migrated_to_approved_usd[annie-rose-foundation-700000] is a gold-spot drift unrelated to the retention phase; carry-forward from prior iterations.
